## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Buddhapakiṇṇakakaṇḍa* ("The Miscellaneous Section on Buddhas", Bv 28) is the twenty-eighth chapter of the *Buddhavaṁsa* in the Pali Canon. It constitutes the penultimate chapter of the collection, preceding the *Dhātubhājanīyakathā* [Adikaram 1946]. Textual historians have noted significant discrepancies between the canonical text of the *Buddhavaṁsa* and its traditional commentary (*Buddhavaṁsa-aṭṭhakathā*); in particular, E. W. Adikaram observes that the commentary does not comment upon the final two chapters of the work, namely the *Buddhapakiṇṇakakaṇḍa* and the *Dhātubhājanīyakathā* [Adikaram 1946].

**Sources**

- [Adikaram 1946] E. W. Adikaram, Early History of Buddhism in Ceylon (1946) — Discussion of the chapter's place in the Buddhavamsa and its absence from the commentary.
